FX-BEVEL-001.says: Bevel Alpha as it starts: edge thickness 2, the light from the upper left at -60, white, intensity 0.4: the card's top and left edges lighter, its bottom and right edges darker, its covering the same.

FX-BEVEL-002.says: Bevel Alpha, edge thickness 0: the frame is the drawing.

FX-BEVEL-003.says: Bevel Alpha, intensity 0: the frame is the drawing.

FX-BEVEL-004.says: Bevel Alpha, the light straight above at 0: the top edge lighter, the bottom darker.

FX-BEVEL-005.says: Bevel Alpha, the light from the right at 90: the right edge lighter, the left darker.

FX-BEVEL-006.says: Bevel Alpha, edge thickness 6: a wider, gentler bevel reaching every pixel of the card.

FX-BEVEL-007.says: Bevel Alpha, a blue light #2040a0 at intensity 1: the lit edges go toward blue, the dark edges toward black.

FX-BEVEL-008.says: Bevel Alpha, edge thickness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frames 2 and 4 bevel at 4 and 8.

FX-BEVEL-009.says: Bevel Alpha, intensity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone above 1 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are the same.

FX-BEVEL-010.says: FX-BEVEL-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-BEVEL-011.says: Bevel Edges as it starts: edge thickness 0.1 of the slab's 10 rows, one pixel: the left column lit by 0.866 of 0.4 and the top row by 0.5 of it, the right column darkened by 0.866 of it and the bottom row by 0.5; the top-left corner pixel goes with the left side; the inside unchanged.

FX-BEVEL-012.says: Bevel Edges, edge thickness 0.3, three pixels: a frame three pixels wide, its corners mitred.

FX-BEVEL-013.says: Bevel Edges, edge thickness 0: the frame is the drawing.

FX-BEVEL-014.says: Bevel Edges, the light from below at 180: the bottom row lit and the top row darkened by the whole 0.4, the left and right columns unchanged.

FX-BEVEL-015.says: Bevel Edges, edge thickness 0.5, five pixels: every pixel is on a face, a four-sided pyramid.

FX-BEVEL-016.says: Bevel Edges, a red light #ff0000 at intensity 1: the lit sides go toward red.

FX-BEVEL-017.says: Bevel Edges, the light angle keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, linear: at frame 2 it is 180, FX-BEVEL-014, and frame 4 is frame 0 again.

FX-BEVEL-018.says: FX-BEVEL-012 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-BEVEL-019.says: Bevel Alpha, edge thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-020.says: Bevel Alpha, edge thickness 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-021.says: Bevel Alpha, intensity 1.1, above 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-022.says: Bevel Alpha, light angle 3601, past ten turns. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-023.says: Bevel Alpha, light colour "white", not a colour written #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-024.says: Bevel Edges, edge thickness 0.6, above 0.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-025.says: Bevel Edges, intensity -0.1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BEVEL-026.says: Bevel Edges, edge thickness keyed to 0.8 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
